item: Minimum bets before skill is distinguishable from luck
why_it_matters: The floor must come from the expected effect size, which needs prices.

item: Closing-line value as the skill signal
why_it_matters: CLV measures whether the model beat the closing price, which separates skill from outcome luck better than ROI.

item: Brier skill score against a baseline
why_it_matters: Brier decomposes into reliability, resolution and uncertainty, so it can separate calibration from luck.
what_is_published: Blank. No probability run and no baseline archive exist.
